classes.CodBi_People_Alphanumeric: Apply to an XTextField that should only accept alphanumeric characters (letters and numbers, no special chars). Useful for IDs, usernames, alphanumeric codes.
classes.CodBi_People_Name: Apply to any XTextField or XTextArea that represents a person's name (e.g. Vorname, Nachname, full name). When you create such a field, you MUST also ensure the 'People' standard configuration is checked/active in the form properties (codbi-prop-standards).
classes.CodBi_People_BuildingNumber: Apply to an XTextField that represents a building/house number in an address. Accepts digits, letters and slashes.
classes.CodBi_People_Mail: Apply to an XTextField that represents an email address. Validates email format.
classes.CodBi_People_18plus: Apply to an XTextField with datatype='dateDE' for date-of-birth fields. Enforces minimum age of 18 years.
classes.CodBi_People_16plus: Apply to an XTextField with datatype='dateDE' for date fields. Enforces minimum age of 16 years.
classes.CodBi_People_Phone: Apply to an XTextField that represents a phone number. Formats input using Cleave with German phone format.
classes.CodBi_People_PLZ: Apply to an XTextField representing a German postal code (PLZ). Formats input using Cleave with 5-digit numeral format.
classes.CodBi_Fotocropper: Apply to the container element of a photo cropper setup. Use together with Fotocropper_Board, Fotocropper_Uploader, Fotocropper_Update, Fotocropper_ImageURL and Fotocropper_Foto.
classes.CodBi_Fotocropper_Board: Apply to the container element that holds the cropper preview board.
classes.CodBi_Fotocropper_Uploader: Apply to the file upload (XUpload) element for the photo cropper.
classes.CodBi_Fotocropper_Update: Apply to the update button element for the photo cropper.
classes.CodBi_Fotocropper_ImageURL: Apply to a hidden field that receives the cropped image URL.
classes.CodBi_Fotocropper_Foto: Apply to the target image element that shows the cropped photo.
classes.CodBi_People_OpenPLZ_AC_SET_PLZ: Apply to the postal code input in an OpenPLZ address autocomplete set within a People context.
classes.CodBi_People_OpenPLZ_AC_SET_Locality: Apply to the locality/city input in an OpenPLZ address autocomplete set within a People context.
classes.CodBi_People_OpenPLZ_AC_SET_Street: Apply to the street input in an OpenPLZ address autocomplete set within a People context.
classes.CodBi_People_OpenPLZ_AC_SET_BuildingNumb: Apply to the building number input in an OpenPLZ address autocomplete set within a People context.
classes.CodBi_OpenPLZ_Select_Localities: Apply to an XSelect that should be filled with localities/cities from OpenPLZ based on the country code in CodBi_OpenPLZ_Country.
classes.CodBi_OpenPLZ_Select_Streets_By_PLZ: Apply to an XSelect that should be filled with streets from OpenPLZ based on the entered postal code.
classes.CodBi_OpenPLZ_Select_Orga_Bundeslaender: Apply to an XSelect that should be filled with German federal states (Bundesländer).
classes.CodBi_OpenPLZ_Select_Orga_Bayern: Apply to an XSelect that should be filled with Bavarian government regions (Regierungsbezirke).
